name: checkbox-group
title: Checkbox Group
description: Shared state for a set of checkboxes, with first-class “select all” - parent, mixed, and the whole-set toggle, built on Base UI Checkbox Group.

meta.whenToUse: A set of related checkboxes sharing one value array - permissions, notification channels, filter facets - and any 'select all' row with a mixed state.
meta.whenNotToUse: Mutually-exclusive choices (RadioGroup); a single standalone toggle (Checkbox); an instant self-saving setting (Switch).
